source_text: The aim of the reaction is test/optimization:  5-fluoro-4-(2-methyl-1-(tetrahydro-2H-pyran-4-yl)-1H-imidazol-5-yl)pyrimidin-2-amine (100 mg, 0.36 mmol), 4-(4-bromo-3-fluorobenzyl)morpholine (109 mg, 0.40 mmol), Palladium, 10% On Charcoal (115 mg, 0.11 mmol), 9,9-Dimethyl-4,5-bis(diphenylphosphino)xanthene (94 mg, 0.16 mmol) and Sodium tert-pentoxide (79 mg, 0.72 mmol) were dissolved in toluene (1.5 mL) and heated to 110 °C under argon.  The reaction was monitorred by HPLC. After 16 h 85 % conversion was achieved. The reaction was stopped and the mixture was discarded.

ChargeMaterial.name: ChargeMaterial
ChargeMaterial.description: Introduce a material into the reaction vessel, retaining both its reported mass and reported amount of substance without deriving either from the other. The literal reagent identity retains formulation qualifiers.
effects: Introduces the identified material into the vessel.

DiscardMixture.name: DiscardMixture
DiscardMixture.description: Discard the identified reaction mixture rather than retaining it for product isolation. Disposal method and destination are retained only when explicitly reported.
effects: Removes the mixture from further synthetic processing by disposal.

Dissolve.name: Dissolve
Dissolve.description: Carry out the reported dissolution of charged materials in the identified solvent. An unspecified dissolution method does not imply stirring, sonication, or complete dissolution of every formulation component.
effects: Records the reported dissolution operation in the charged solvent.

MonitorReactionProgress.name: MonitorReactionProgress
MonitorReactionProgress.description: Monitor the reaction using the reported analytical method and retain the conversion observation at the reported elapsed reaction time. Conversion is an analytical observation, not an instruction to transform material or an isolated yield. Sampling technique and monitoring frequency remain unspecified unless reported.
effects: Records analytical monitoring and the reported conversion observation at the stated elapsed time.
Does not assert isolation, yield, or a specific sampling procedure.

StopReaction.name: StopReaction
StopReaction.description: Terminate the ongoing reaction operation by the reported method. If the method is not reported, no cooling, quenching, reagent addition, or other termination mechanism is implied.
effects: Records termination of the reaction operation without asserting a termination mechanism.
